# FQHETorusCorrelation

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnTorus` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnTorus/FQHETorusCorrelation`

```text
FCIHofstadterCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FCIHofstadterCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --state : name of the vector file describing the state whose density has to be plotted
    --density : plot density instead of density-density correlation
    --k-space : compute the density/correlation in momentum space
    --subtract-density : subtract the average density from the density-density correlation
    -x, --reference-x : x-coordinate or reference site (default value = 0)
    -y, --reference-y : y-coordinate or reference site (default value = 0)

plot options:
    --output : output file name (default output name replace the .vec extension of the input file with .rho or .rhorho)
    --nbr-samplesx : number of samples along the x direction (value must be greater than 3, default value = 30)
    --nbr-samplesy : number of samples along the y direction (value must be greater than 3, default value = 30)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
